note: V_THM-A1B1-10 - first abstract trunk layer - 3x12 - F9 2026-09-03: the 12 words a2_ideas already teaches at A2 were removed (A2 owns them); refilled with 24 over-level nouns promoted out of a2_ideas, with their sentences. Sentence bank added for the seeds too. · F9 2026-09-03: intro built — recycle table, decision_flow (abstract nouns do not picture), make/have/take collocations. · B22 2026-09-04: quiz_mode sentence_gap — Quiz/Type were the Match word list again; the 36-frame bank was already complete and gappable, so this is the whole fix. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: E10 — Use was CZ→EN of the 36-frame bank. use_mode rewrite with 12 underlined paraphrases now makes Use production of the abstract noun (*What he knows about cars* → knowledge, *nothing to show that he was there* → evidence, *another way* → alternative), which is the only shape that drills an abstract noun at all. Nothing else touched. · 2026-09-04: eleven rewrite items where the swap could not reconstruct the answer — abstract nouns need their determiner and preposition frame already standing in the prompt, so the underline covers only the paraphrase. · 2026-09-05 F7/F9: 7 words dropped from the bank and moved onto the You already know page (extended) — problem, reason, opinion, advice, goal, knowledge, relationship. An earlier unit owns them; they stay in this unit's sentences as recycled vocabulary. The first pass on 2026-09-05 did this backwards, stripping such words off the page and leaving them in the bank.

intro.title: Which word do you need?
labels: You want to say what you think?
You want to say how it is done?
B1 talk is built from these, not from things you can point at.

rows: an effort · an arrangement · a discovery
